glosses: forehead (part of the face above the eyebrows and below the hairline)

examples.en: He kissed me on the forehead.

examples.text: Ele colocou a mão na testa.
examples.en: He put his hand to his forehead.

examples.text: Ele beijou a filha dele na testa.
examples.en: He kissed his daughter on the forehead.
She kissed him on the forehead.

examples.text: Ele limpou o suor da testa.
examples.en: He wiped the sweat from his forehead.
